Triage: lands in area:cloud · domain:server · Bug · p2 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: on a deployment that declares email-and-password sign-in off and stores nothing, Setup › Authentication shows the toggle on (the setting answers the manifest default `true`, while the public config answers `false`). An administrator reads a wrong state for a security-relevant switch. Measured at `SettingsService.get`, and it affects self-hosted deployments too. The sign-in itself stays off, so p2, beside #34174 (p2). Recorded 2026-11-27T18:12Z.
